hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */RapidsolDestek/*.cs) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && dotnet format RapidsolDestek.slnx --include "${f#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/}" --no-restore -v q >/dev/null 2>&1; dotnet build RapidsolDestek.slnx -v q --nologo 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|Error' && exit 2 || exit 0 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */mockups/*.html) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node tools/check-i18n.mjs --mockups-only || exit 2 ;; *.cshtml|*.resx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node tools/check-i18n.mjs --resx-only || exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */Migrations/*) echo 'BLOCKED: never hand-edit EF migrations — regenerate with dotnet ef' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$c" in *'git push'*main*) echo 'BLOCKED: pushes to main are PR-only' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
